requiredNegativeCases.description: Unknown source query names must not be assumed removed by redirects or copied URLSearchParams.
Repeated names must be rejected or normalized by an approved single-value schema.
Percent encoding must not bypass a forbidden-name decision.
Double encoding must not bypass decoding and validation boundaries.
Bracket/array syntax must not create an unreviewed multi-value channel.
Case variants must not bypass an exact approved name set.
Unicode confusables must not impersonate an approved ASCII parameter.
Login return intent must not preserve raw query, fragment, or record locator state.
Decoded slash, traversal, and control input must not cross a route-segment boundary.
Protocol-relative, absolute, and backslash targets must not become login/navigation destinations.

criticalFlows.requiredDecision: Replace or constrain raw URL intent only after a registered global URL/privacy decision.

limitations: Static syntax cannot determine whether a value is personal data, public, secret, or an authorized object locator.
Computed target/key and unresolved shared-component route context remain ambiguous and therefore fail-closed.
This repository census does not observe CDN, reverse-proxy, browser-history, support-ticket, or production analytics retention.
Candidate-allow is a review recommendation only; every state item remains approvalStatus=unverified.
No runtime sanitizer, redirect behavior, login intent, pending decision, ADR, proxy, or Next configuration is changed by this artifact.
